title: Isle Royale source and layer catalog

items.label: Current visitor map geometry
items.notes: Primary runtime source is the public visitor web map when readable. If it fails, the tool can fall back to a public 2021 Isle Royale FeatureServer with POIs, trails, and park boundary before using approximate local anchors. Current closures, regulations, transportation, and campground status always hand off to current NPS pages.

items.label: Visitor map fallback item
items.notes: Secondary public web map item. If both web-map items fail, a public 2021 FeatureServer is tried before any approximate local anchors.

items.label: Regional access and transportation map
items.notes: Use as a planning/reference source; operational transportation information must be verified against current NPS and operators.

items.label: Rock Harbor area guide
items.notes: Direct NPS Rock Harbor Area Guide (2015). Use for facility/orientation context; current operational status still comes from current NPS pages.

items.label: Windigo area guide
items.notes: Direct NPS Windigo Area Guide (2015). Use for facility/orientation context; current operational status still comes from current NPS pages.

items.label: Off-trail camping zones
items.notes: Isle Royale uses 46 off-trail camping zones on the permit map. Current closure zone numbers are parsed from the NPS Current Conditions feed and surfaced as operational status without inventing polygon geometry; verify the current permit map and conditions before departure.

items.label: Ferry, seaplane and water access
items.notes: Public web-map routes may render at runtime; current schedules remain external operational data.

items.label: Shipwrecks and dive sites
items.notes: Publish only public visitor-facing wreck locations. Never expose sensitive resource fields by default.

items.label: Relief / terrain reference
items.notes: Prefer a licensed/self-hosted terrain source over scraping presentation artwork.

items.label: Isle Royale lighthouses
items.notes: Four lighthouse locations; current access restrictions must come from current NPS information.

items.label: Geology
items.publisher: National Park Service Geologic Resources Inventory
items.notes: Generated from the NPS GRI GeoPackage: 1,975 geologic-unit features, reprojected and simplified for web use. Manifest records SHA-256 and source accuracy caveat; not survey-grade.
items.vintage: NPS GRI digital release 2021; older source mapping

items.label: Vegetation baseline (2000)
items.notes: Historical baseline only. The 19,072 source polygons are dissolved into 38 TNC_DESCRI vegetation classes and simplified for opt-in web display. Do not interpret as current forest condition.

items.label: Vegetation inventory — simplified
items.notes: Generate from detailed classes when possible instead of digitizing the simplified artwork.

items.label: Quiet / No-Wake zones — 22 official polygons
items.notes: The 22 official NPS zone files are assembled one-zone-per-file. Mott, Rock Harbor/Snug Harbor, and Washington Harbor are classified as the three No-Wake zones from the current compendium; the remaining 19 are Quiet/No-Wake zones.
items.vintage: Official NPS DataStore Collection 9705; 22 per-zone GeoJSON files validated against the 2026 Superintendent's Compendium

items.label: Anchorage zones
items.notes: Direct NPS Anchorage Zones map (2018), retained as an official boating-planning reference. Verify current restrictions and conditions before acting.

items.label: Archived brochure map
items.publisher: National Park Service; discovered via NPMaps
items.notes: Historical/reference layer only. Never present old route or regulation information as current.

items.label: Historic Windigo Nature Trail map
items.publisher: National Park Service; discovered via NPMaps
items.notes: Date-stamp and keep disabled by default if later georeferenced.

items.label: Boat-in campground facilities
items.notes: Fetched through the same-origin Isle Royale API and matched to mapped campgrounds by normalized public place name. Includes dock depth, shelters, tent sites, food lockers, stay limit, fire/grill and generator fields when NPS supplies them.

items.label: Current Isle Royale conditions and closures
items.notes: Fetched through the same-origin Isle Royale API. The tool detects only closure patterns it knows how to parse and never treats a no-match result as proof that the park has no alerts.

items.label: Vegetation change, 1996–2017
items.vintage: 2017 high-resolution imagery compared with the 2000 NPS vegetation map (1994/1996 imagery)
items.notes: Shows mapped vegetation cover type, density or pattern change and proposed reasons from the USGS release; not a present-day 2026 vegetation map.

items.label: 2021 Horne Fire burn severity
items.vintage: 2021 Horne Fire; USGS data release published 2024
items.notes: Burn-severity assessment derived from pre/post-fire high-resolution imagery; use as historical ecological context, not a current fire-status layer.
